'''Tanbai''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Easuhura]], the reigning [[FLLA World Cup]] champions following their victory at the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]] and the eighteenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 9,360,000 at the [[Easuhura|Easuhuran]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|fortieth-largest city in the world]] by population. The Easuhuran Federal Museum, located in Tanbai, displays '''The Aldarra''', the permanent trophy of the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]]. [[Easuhura]] previously hosted the [[1660 FLLA World Cup|1660]] and [[1716 FLLA World Cup|1716]] editions of the FLLA World Cup.
